name: Hisaya Masashi
source:
The protagonist of this game. He is a new math teacher in his first year out of college.

In the midst of a difficult employment situation, he is given a lifetime appointment at his new school through Mr. Iori's connections, but he is half happy and half conflicted when he finds out that it is a private, escalator-style all-girls school.

He's no good around groups of girls.

[translated from [url=https://www.pandora.nu/az/wakaba_top.html]official website[/url]]
